create_InferenceSettings: create an InferenceSettings dataclass to configure MLIP inference with tf32, activation checkpointing, and precision options
build_inference_settings_default: build a python module that calls inference_settings_default to get default MLIP inference configuration
run_inference_settings_turbo: run inference_settings_turbo to get optimized settings for long simulations with constant composition
test_inference_settings_traineval: test inference_settings_traineval to get settings matching the default training and evaluation mode
review_guess_inference_settings: review guess_inference_settings to resolve a string name or InferenceSettings object into the correct settings
